about: E-blind-v2 blind held-out set (second blind set for the C1 supersession climb). Every 'text' is a verbatim User line of a chat written by a free hosted LLM (gpt-oss-120b / gpt-oss-20b) that saw only the r15 neutral spec with the topic substituted (no compressor, rule, or earlier set). Gold values and categories come deterministically from each text's own KEY section (convert_v2.py); the experimenter added only the probe questions, the noise topic and the padding (harness). raw_sha256 = sha256 of the raw blind text file (kept outside the repo).

categories.UPD_SAME: KEY type update; first and last statement share >= half their content words
categories.TWO_OLD: KEY still-true similar pair, member said first (gated, old-fact LOSS)
categories.TWO_NEW: KEY still-true similar pair, member said second (report-only)
categories.STATIC: KEY fact / free-form / one-off with a code (gated recall)
